Honey Vision AI

OCR, translation, grammar correction & read-aloud — powered by Gemini or Claude

1Connect Your AI Key

Pick which model does the reading. Everything below — extraction, translation, grammar checking, prompt suggestions — runs on whichever provider is selected here.
Uses Anthropic's Messages API directly from this browser tab. Your Claude key never touches any server other than api.anthropic.com.
Telling the model the script up front helps it read old/handwritten South Indian-language documents more accurately — it stops guessing the language and pays closer attention to that script's letterforms, including archaic ones.
Handwriting mode reads a handwritten page verbatim in its own script — no translation, no spelling fixes, no reflowing — using the full page plus zoomed-in strips of it so every letter and vowel sign gets real pixels, then proofreads the result line by line against the page.
Forces every page to be upscaled far more aggressively than the automatic setting, even if it's already a decent resolution — worth turning on for a page packed with small, dense, or old cursive handwriting. Slower per page, and it still can't invent a reading for a spot that's genuinely illegible in the source photo — it just gives the model more actual pixels to work with per character.
Required — used only to label this document in History. Downloaded files keep your original file's own name.

Tell Gemini what you actually want out of this document (e.g. "pull out the account holder name, account number, IFSC code, and every transaction as a table"). Click "Suggest a prompt" to have it look at the file and draft one for you first, then edit it however you like before extracting.

3Re-uploaded the Document
